The second equation describes the perpendicular bisector of the points \(4+k\) and \(k+3i\), which is the line
\[
4x-3y=4k+\frac72.
\]
The first equation is the circle centered at \(25+20i\) with radius \(5\):
\[
(x-25)^2+(y-20)^2=25.
\]
For the system to have exactly one solution, the line must be tangent to the circle, so the distance from \((25,20)\) to the line must equal \(5\):
\[
\frac{|4(25)-3(20)-4k-\frac72|}{5}=5.
\]
\[
\frac{|40-4k-\frac72|}{5}=5
\]
\[
\left|\frac{73}{2}-4k\right|=25
\]
\[
|73-8k|=50.
\]
Thus
\[
73-8k=50 \Rightarrow k=\frac{23}{8},
\]
or
\[
73-8k=-50 \Rightarrow k=\frac{123}{8}.
\]
The sum of all possible values of \(k\) is
\[
\frac{23}{8}+\frac{123}{8}=\frac{146}{8}=\frac{73}{4}.
\]
So \(m=73,\ n=4\), and \(m+n=77\).

ANSWER: 77
